items.title: The Many Islands of “America”
items.summary: A show on art from Cuba, Guam, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and their diasporas touches on themes of colonization, enslavement, migration, and more.

items.title: This October, Experience Refract: The Seattle Glass Experience
items.summary: Seattle’s glass festival returns with milestone anniversaries, fresh art, parties, demos, exhibits, and open studios with the vibrant theme Year of Celebration.

items.title: Applications Open: IDSVA Low-Residency PhD Program for Artists and Creative Thinkers
items.summary: Begin your PhD journey in summer 2027 with residencies in Rome, Spannocchia Castle, Arezzo, and Siena.

items.title: Alfredo Jaar’s America
items.summary: We interview the Chilean artist as an iconic work returns to NYC, Trump’s attacks against abstract sculptures, James McNeill Whistler’s musical paintings, and more.
